title: Katherine Kasolas-Jacobson
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Katherine Kasolas-Jacobson is a member of the Orchard Elementary School District Board of Trustees in California. She assumed office on December 9, 2022. Her current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Kasolas-Jacobson is running for re-election to the Orchard Elementary School District Board of Trustees in California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
